notes.title: V1.2.12
notes.content:
1. Bugs on the number of times to repair unknown organisms
2. Add Lion Palace.
3. Add a few achievements.
4. Skill adjustment:
Defense: increases defense by 20% during battles, with an 80% chance of individual attacks attacking oneself
Evasion: Physical attack evasion+30%
Rebirth: On death, there is a 30% chance of resurrection
Survival: At death, there is a 50% chance of retaining 1 point of health
Resilience: When the health is less than 50%, the damage received is halved
Calm down: When receiving damage exceeding 15% of the maximum health limit, refresh the CD
Blocking: When receiving a physical attack, 30% triggers blocking and the damage received is halved
Persist: unable to evade, but increases block probability by 30%, only effective when possessing block skills
Transfer: When an enemy individual attacks and locks themselves, there is a 80% chance that they will search for the target again
